proof_summary: Finite primality-witness tables establish Goldbach for the even cases through 8012 and Lemoine for the odd cases through 15727; above those bounds, a supplied witness gives primes \(q\) and \(p=n-q\) in the even case, or \(p=n-2q\) in the odd case, yielding the required decompositions. For any bound \(a\), applying the even case at \(n=2a+8014\) gives \(2q<n\) and primes \(p\) and \(p-6\), so \(p-6>a\) is the lower member of a cousin-prime pair, proving such pairs are unbounded and hence infinite.
